symbols.name: fractional bit count
symbols.meaning: The number of binary places kept after the point in each stored value.
symbols.quote: Each stored value keeps $p$ fractional bits, the number of binary places after the point.

symbols.name: stored-value unit
symbols.meaning: The size $2^{-p}$ of one unit in the last place of a stored value.
symbols.quote: Write $h_p = 2^{-p}$ for the size of one unit in the last place of a stored value, so an error measured in units of $h_p$ is an absolute error below that multiple of $h_p$.

symbols.name: digit width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each radix digit, where $b = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$.
symbols.quote: The source sets $b = \lceil \log_2 n\rceil$, the number of bits in each radix digit, and $p = 6b$, so $h_p = 2^{-6b}$.

symbols.name: computed value
symbols.meaning: A computed approximation of a true integer coefficient.
symbols.quote: If a computed value $x$ satisfies $|x - m| < 1/2$ for an integer $m$, then every other integer is farther than $1/2$ from $x$, so $m$ is the unique nearest integer and rounding returns $m$.

symbols.name: true integer
symbols.meaning: The integer coefficient that the computed value approximates.
symbols.quote: If a computed value $x$ satisfies $|x - m| < 1/2$ for an integer $m$, then every other integer is farther than $1/2$ from $x$, so $m$ is the unique nearest integer and rounding returns $m$.

symbols.name: padded transform size
symbols.meaning: The number of entries in the padded transform box, a power of two.
symbols.quote: Here $T$ is the number of entries in the padded transform box, a power of two chosen in $[4n/b, 8n/b)$, and $L = \log_2 T$.

symbols.name: log transform size
symbols.meaning: The base-two logarithm $\log_2 T$ of the padded transform size.
symbols.quote: Here $T$ is the number of entries in the padded transform box, a power of two chosen in $[4n/b, 8n/b)$, and $L = \log_2 T$.

symbols.name: source-length product
symbols.meaning: The product of the pairwise coprime source lengths.
symbols.quote: Here $S$ is the product of the pairwise coprime source lengths, and $\gamma$ is a construction constant with $\gamma = o(b)$.

symbols.name: construction constant
symbols.meaning: A construction constant that the parameter choice makes $o(b)$.
symbols.quote: Here $S$ is the product of the pairwise coprime source lengths, and $\gamma$ is a construction constant with $\gamma = o(b)$.

relations.quote: This step bounds the error of [Convolution over the polynomial ring](polynomial-ring-convolution.md) by $5TL\,h_p$.
It takes its guard widths from the [guard-width bound](guard-width-bound.md), so each stored value is exact and only the stated truncations contribute error.
It counts the error of the [phase twist](phase-twist.md) at each end, each below $4h_p$, so these errors enter the same sum.
